finalText:
Found the leak. In `processOrder.js`, when `run()` threw an error during order validation, the connection release was never reached because it came after the await. Connections with bad payloads were left in the pool's in-use set indefinitely, starving new requests.

Fixed it by wrapping the call in try-finally so the release runs regardless of failure. All 4 tests pass now — the pool fully recovers even when orders fail validation.
